title: Settings/Enterprise Structure Define Default Layout for Tabs
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:41 AM
You have the following options:

e If you want to use the standard SAP layout, do not make any changes.

e If you want to define your own layout then establish the following settings:

o a.In Customizing, choose |)*Move-In/Out » Move-In » Configure Tabs for Move-In Screen |). Here you can define
your own layout.

o b.Enter the layout in Customizing as a default layout in Customizing under |}*SAP Utilities » Basic
Settings/Enterprise Structure Define Default Layout for Tabs

Service Notifications and Orders

Use

In Customizing under |sDevice Management » Meter Reading » Basic Settings » Define Control Parameters fir Meter Reading
Data Processing, 3 you can configure the system to create a service order or service notification for the move-in meter reading
(provided that plausible meter readings do not already exist for the metering devices). You can establish this settings separately
for each division.Customizing entries with an empty company code key are relevant to this process, since the system does not yet

know the company code in move-in initial processing. You can use enhancement ECSBTMRI]I (Assign default values for creation of
service notifications/orders).

You can also do this in Customizing under |}»Device Management » Meter Reading » Basic Settings » Define Control Group for
Creation of Multiple MR Orders §., you define whether the system creates service notifications or service orders, and whether
these or stored at device, device location or connection object level.

Alternatively, you can integrate the creation of service notifications and orders into a workflow, in which case creation is not
immediate but postponed. You do this in Customizing under Define System Parameters for Move-In and Move-Out . Prerequisites
for this are the method MovelnDocument.MeterReadingServicelnitiate (Trigger service management for meter reading) and the
parameter DelayedMeterReadServ V in event MovelnDocument.Created for object type MOVEINDOC (move-in document).

If you reverse a move-in, the system adjusts the status of the service notifications/orders generated during move-in creation as

follows:

e The status Completed is allocated to the service notifications.
e The status Not executed is allocated to service orders that were not released.

e The status Technically completed is allocated to service orders that were released.

If you change a move-in date, the system proceeds as though the move-in had been reversed and re-created for another date.

Features

On the move-in screen, you can have the system generate a service order or notification, regardless of the default settings you
have made. If the parameter was set and the register results were completely entered (determined by the default settings), and
you still want to create a service order/notification, then you must reset the register results using the Reset function key.
Otherwise, the system saves the register results and a service notification/order is no longer required.
